p.i: tatem perfectam, & sanitatem integram omnibus infirmis, atque in angustia positis, qui magnam tuam miserationis pulsant januam, ut ignoscas, mundes, & purges peccata, & maculas nostras, & Defunctorum nostrorum.

main_text.p: Haec pauca ex multis, unde planissime patet, Syros, quemadmodum & reliquas Orientis gentes non solum Defunctos Deo commendare, ut ipsum tempore ultimi Judicij clementem resuscitati experiantur Judicem; verum etiam, ut eorum animas purget, ac mundet a sordibus, & maculis iniquitatis, eisque peccata, & delicta ignoscat. Concluditur his itaque Hottingerus, & enormissimorum mendaciorum ex more agitur reus. Quamobrem concludamus & nos Epistolam hanc nostram, tibi clarissime, & doctissime Leo, Nestoreos depre-cantes annos, ut diutissime incolumis, & sospes vivens Ecclesiam Catholicam tuis eruditissimis Scriptis exornare pergas, & Vulpeculis, quae fraudibus, & astutia vivunt, & scriptitant, terror, Leo semper sis, dolosque & fallacias in dies aperias; Titanos vero, & gigantes cum Deo, eiusque bellantes Ecclesia, veritatis gladio conficias, & prosternas. Felix diu Vale.

page.notes: Long s was normalised to s and i/j, u/v per the rules. The top paragraph appears to be set in italic type; the italic marking follows the scan. The catchword "Quid" is set at the lower right. The dark edge strip on the right and the small marks beside it come from the neighbouring page and were left out. No signature is visible.
